notes.title: [Knights College Updated to Ver2.0.1]
notes.content:
[Knights College Updated to Ver2.0.1]
Changed the title screen to show the main unit version and patch version.
When the language is set to Chinese, the title logo will be displayed in Chinese.
Fixed a bug that prevented the "Maximize sensitivity of all" achievement from being completed.
Fixed a bug that prevented the achievement "Maximize everyone's sensitivity" from being completed.
Fixed other minor bugs and typos.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)
